excerpts.label: Early window
excerpts.quote: The bank as proposed to be constituted can not be relied on during the war to provide a circulating medium nor to furnish loans or antici-pations of the public revenue.
excerpts.title: January 30, 1815: Veto Message on the National Bank
excerpts.cite: James Madison, Veto Message on the National Bank, 1815

excerpts.label: Highest-supported window
excerpts.quote: Yet the commerce and currency of the country are suffering evils from the operations of the State banks which can not and ought not to be overlooked.
excerpts.title: December 2, 1839: Third Annual Message to Congress
excerpts.cite: Martin Van Buren, Third Annual Message to Congress, 1839

excerpts.label: Recent window
excerpts.quote: We've cut off Russia's largest bank - a bank that holds more than one third of Russia's banking assets by itself - cut it off from the US financial system.
excerpts.title: February 24, 2022: Remarks on the Russian Invasion of Ukraine
excerpts.cite: Joe Biden, Remarks on the Russian Invasion of Ukraine, 2022
